toolkit_connection_statuses.description: NetHunt is a Gmail CRM that brings sales automation and drip campaigns straight to your inbox
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=nethunt_crm. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="nethunt_crm") to create a connection BEFORE executing any nethunt_crm tools.

NETHUNT_CRM_FIND_RECORDS.description: Tool to find records by ID or text query in NetHunt CRM. Search for records within a folder using record ID or search query. Use when you need to locate specific records in a folder.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Default: 1 if not specified.

query.description: Search query to narrow records returned. Either recordId or query must be specified to perform the search.

folder_id.description: Folder ID to find records in. This identifies the folder within NetHunt CRM where the search will be performed.

record_id.description: Record ID if available. Either recordId or query must be specified to perform the search.

NETHUNT_CRM_LIST_READABLE_FOLDERS.description: Tool to list all accessible folders in NetHunt CRM. Returns folders the user has read access to. Use when you need to retrieve available folders for organizing or accessing records.

NETHUNT_CRM_LIST_FOLDER_FIELDS.description: Tool to list folder fields in NetHunt CRM. Returns the field definitions for a specific folder. Use when you need to retrieve all field metadata for a given folder ID.

folderId.description: Folder ID to list fields for
